changes: Add standard eciGeneratePhonemes with native phoneme bytes, owned caller buffer bounds, native index callbacks, retry/abort/Stop, Unicode admission and active dictionaries. Preserve the PCM output route.
Add eciPause for callback output, resumable from another thread or the callback. Stop and public Reset clear the pause. Synthesis and phoneme output remain synchronous.

Correct fractional glottal closure for Classic profiles at 16 kHz and above, with a compact triangular reconstruction correction across the real closure time. Retain period phase, durations and AH/AF masks. Explicitly initialize all new state in the ordinary numeric source constructor.

Remove the prior 4.5-kHz periodic shelf. From 22.05 kHz open native glottal tilt by at most 0.3 native steps, weighted by rate. Preserve source DC gain and the 16-kHz contour; stronger prototypes exceeded female PCM headroom and are not shipped.

Fit gradual Classic tract motion at 2-ms intervals, retain immediate fits for large transitions, and use a 3-ms coefficient ramp. Only the live current filter state is retained; no speech/PCM results are cached.
Preserve the accepted AF consonant path and profile A. Keep SDK changes independent of any particular NVDA client.

DSP_performance.method: Three interleaved baseline/new runs per dataset; process user CPU time; Linux x64 host. DSP frame replay only, excluding text analysis and NVDA playback.
DSP_performance.baseline: Retained dev8 replay; dev9 used identical DSP.
DSP_performance.limits: Not Windows-on-ARM latency, not a measurement of player starvation or stuttering on the user device. Timings do not establish listening quality.

reference.description: User-supplied original ibmeci.dll; static inspection only; not redistributed.

limits: No claim that audible crackling, voiced-body quality or occasional stuttering are fully resolved. NVDA listening on the user device remains necessary.
49 exports include 45 original names and four ReLoq extensions; this does not establish full behavioral ECI parity.
Windows runtime CI is configured separately and must finish before claiming Windows runtime validation.

15 original exports remain absent. Synthesis/phoneme output are synchronous; fragment snapshots, TextMode 2/3, NumberMode, phoneme indices, device/file/filter output and Asian MainDictExt remain incomplete.
The ordinary numerical source and profile A retain legacy behavior. The Classic 16-kHz contour remains, but its corrected source and smoother filter transitions intentionally change its PCM.
Peak checks cover the listed models/texts/control combinations, not every possible utterance and parameter combination.
